Lula will take office in 2027.

summary_en: The foreign ministers of China and Kyrgyzstan issued a joint press communique, reviewing the achievements of 47 years of diplomatic relations and stating they will continue to support each other and expand practical cooperation. The two sides discussed the situation in the Horn of Africa and the security of Red Sea shipping lanes.

summary: 第54届世界体操锦标赛在荷兰鹿特丹落幕，中国体操队获3金2银2铜，并取得2028年洛杉矶奥运会男、女团体参赛资格。女队以165.764分时隔20年再夺世锦赛团体冠军，终结美国队七连冠；男队获团体季军。个人项目中，邹敬园夺得男子双杠冠军，收获
summary_en: The 54th World Artistic Gymnastics Championships concluded in Rotterdam, Netherlands. The Chinese gymnastics team won 3 gold, 2 silver and 2 bronze medals and qualified for both men's and women's team events at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.
